_note: General tolerances per ISO 2768-1 (linear dimensions, ± mm) and common ISO 286 fits. Process capability values are typical shop numbers, not guarantees.

fits.use: Loose running fit for wide commercial tolerances, pins in exposed linkages
Free running, large temperature swings or high speeds
Close running, accurate location on shafts at moderate speed
Sliding fit, parts move and turn freely and locate accurately
Locational clearance, snug fit for stationary parts that can be assembled by hand
Locational transition, accurate location with slight interference possible
Locational interference / light press fit, rigid alignment
Medium drive fit, permanent assembly of steel parts

design_rules.rule: Holes print undersize by ~0.1–0.2 mm; ream or add clearance for fits
Overhangs beyond 45° need supports; orient the largest flat face on the bed
Minimum wall ≈ 1.2 mm (3 perimeters at 0.4 mm nozzle)
Hollow parts need drain holes ≥ 3 mm; minimum wall ≈ 0.6 mm
No supports needed; minimum wall ≈ 0.8 mm, escape holes for hollow parts
Internal corners need a radius ≥ tool radius (≥ 1.5 mm typical); avoid deep narrow pockets (depth > 4× width)
Thin walls below 0.8 mm (metal) / 1.5 mm (plastic) chatter and deflect
2D profiles only; kerf ≈ 0.1–0.3 mm; minimum feature ≈ material thickness
Uniform wall 1–4 mm, draft ≥ 1°, avoid undercuts unless side actions are budgeted
